title: OTHRYS OS project-to-mission context selection
goal: Let controller-local projects scope the visible Work surface without changing canonical mission truth or gaining execution authority.
laws: Selected project context is controller-local presentation state only.
Canonical mission evidence remains unchanged and machine-derived.
Project selection may relabel visible context but cannot rewrite mission identity.
No project context is sent to model, shell, Factory, Trust Canal or Worker.
Canonical othrys-v2 context is always recoverable in one tap.
Refresh preserves selected local context on the controller.
No new API or machine write is added.

slices.title: Bind project context to Work surface labels
Prove canonical mission truth remains unchanged
